item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
I can't help but feel disappointed about this. It's not that it's bad; far from it. It's just that I was expecting more. I had pictured something more akin to old-fashioned circus posters with anomalous hand monsters and flame-engulfed men. Obviously, this would be impractical because a) the requirement that the "documents" be easily replicable b) this is an amateur writing site, rather than a professional graphic design sign. The use of minimal text to mimic it produces mixed results. Still, while this evokes some of the sense of wonder that seems to have been part and parcel of these things (thirding the FL comparison), I wish that there was more. If not graphically, at least in terms of writing.

This isn't a problem with the article as such, just a complaint about what I feel is unrealized potential. The article itself is good enough for an upvote, to be sure.
